Ми — Astra Systems, команда студентів ФКРКМ із Дніпра. Нас об’єднують інтерес до космосу, програмування та створення інтерактивних технологій. Працюємо над Lunar Ops — навчальним симулятором, у якому гравці керують місячною базою, розподіляють ресурси й ухвалюють рішення для безпеки екіпажу.

Наші напрями — веброзробка, UI/UX-дизайн, ігрові механіки та робота з відкритими даними NASA. Використовуємо TypeScript, React і NestJS, поєднуючи інженерний підхід із виразним візуальним стилем.
summary:
Lunar Ops is an interactive, browser-based lunar outpost management simulator developed by Astra Systems for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Players command a crew through a seven-day lunar mission, balancing energy, oxygen, water, morale, and crew health while working toward a scientific research goal. Each day provides a limited number of actions, requiring players to make meaningful decisions about station maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, crew assignments, and unexpected mission events.

The application features an interactive lunar base, resource telemetry, a mission journal, and two difficulty levels. Every decision affects the mission's outcome, encouraging players to think critically about resource allocation, planning, and survival in a challenging environment.

Our goal is to make space exploration concepts accessible and engaging for young learners by transforming complex engineering trade-offs into an interactive educational experience.
details:
Lunar Ops — Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

Project Overview

Lunar Ops is an interactive, browser-based educational simulator developed by Astra Systems for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our goal is to help young learners understand the challenges of operating a lunar base through exploration, strategic decision-making, and interactive gameplay.

How It Works

Players take command of the Horizon-01 lunar outpost for a seven-day mission. Their objective is to keep the crew alive while collecting at least 60 scientific research points.

Each day, players can perform two operations, forcing them to prioritize competing needs. They must manage energy, oxygen, water, crew morale, health, and spare parts while conducting scientific research and maintaining life-support systems.

Players can upgrade solar panels, water and oxygen recycling systems, a hydroponic greenhouse, and a research laboratory. Crew members can be assigned different professional roles, including engineer, scientist, and medic.

The simulator also introduces mission emergencies, such as solar storms, air leaks, and potential lunar ice discoveries. Each scenario presents decisions with different consequences.

Technology and Implementation

Lunar Ops is built using a modern TypeScript-based architecture:

  • Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Recharts, and Framer Motion.
  • Backend: NestJS with REST APIs and Zod request validation.
  • Simulation Engine: A deterministic game engine that calculates resource consumption, production, crew health, scientific progress, and mission outcomes.
  • Development: pnpm workspaces and Turborepo.
  • Deployment: Vercel hosting with frontend-to-backend API routing.

The game engine is separated from the user interface, making the system modular, testable, and extensible.

Innovation and Educational Value

Instead of presenting space exploration as a collection of facts, Lunar Ops transforms engineering challenges into interactive decisions with measurable consequences.

Players experience the importance of resource management, infrastructure planning, scientific priorities, and teamwork.

The game includes interactive station visualization, resource telemetry, mission history, and two difficulty levels.

Scientific Context

The simulation is inspired by real challenges associated with lunar exploration, including life-support systems, radiation hazards, and resource utilization. Resource values and mission scenarios are simplified educational models rather than live NASA telemetry or engineering-grade predictions.

Future Development

Our vision is to expand Lunar Ops with additional mission scenarios, enhanced educational content, persistent multiplayer-ready mission storage, and integrations with relevant open space-science datasets.

Through Lunar Ops, we aim to inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers, and space explorers.

NASA Resources and Scientific Foundations

Lunar Ops draws on publicly available NASA educational and scientific resources concerning lunar water ice, space radiation hazards, and environmental control and life-support systems. These resources inform the scientific context of our educational scenarios. Gameplay parameters, resource values, and mission events are simplified simulations created for learning purposes; the current version does not retrieve or process live NASA datasets.
